dialogues.speaker: Okawara Goemon
dialogues.text: What is it? You need anything?

dialogues.speaker: Okawara Goemon
dialogues.text: You don't even know who I am? Ignorant outlander.

dialogues.speaker: Okawara Goemon
dialogues.text: I'm the Chief Samurai of the Tenryou Commission. I'm in charge of the security of the Kujou Clan.

dialogues.speaker: Okawara Goemon
dialogues.text: Everyone knows that I am the best swordsman in Inazuma. You better not try any mischief in front of me.

dialogues.speaker: Okawara Goemon
dialogues.text: That's right. I have always pursued perfection in my swordsmanship, and I have already reached that perfect state.

dialogues.speaker: Okawara Goemon
dialogues.text: As far as I am concerned, the best swordsmanship requires you to rely on your own strength, not some heretical Vision.

dialogues.speaker: Okawara Goemon
dialogues.text: My fellow students couldn't even scratch me with their elemental powers. I even managed to seize their Visions. What a bunch of clowns!

dialogues.speaker: Okawara Goemon
dialogues.text: Oh? Are you also a swordsman without a Vision? Not bad. If you keep up with your training and somehow become one thousandth the swordsman that I am, I'd say that you've done pretty well for yourself.
